_comment: The GNOME lines this project audits, and the container each one can be opened in. Fedora ships one GNOME line per release, so a release image is a line. `expects` is the prefix the container's `gnome-shell --version` must start with, checked before anything is measured: a tag that has been moved or repointed must fail loudly rather than quietly verify a different line. A release whose repositories have left the live mirrors is handled by the runner, which retries against the release archive.
